summary: My v3 blocker is repaired and I verified it by set comparison rather than by reading the claim: doctorV4FieldMapping.destinations holds exactly nineteen entries in perfect bijection with the nineteen closed members, with no member unmapped and no destination key that is not a member. actor and actionSubtype now carry destinations with DENY semantics, and the effectOutcome asymmetry I flagged is closed by an explicit notAnAuthorizationRecordMember note. Both my advisories are repaired, one of them recording the wrong digest I measured so the error cannot recur. Every axis the prompt names comes back clean, and three of my probes were attempts to break repairs that held: the CA-2 supersession cites a real doctor v4 recital whose text I read in full and which does say what the artifact says it says; IN_PROCESS is classified, denied, and explicitly given no commit boundary so it cannot be relabeled as SPAWN; and the CA-4 commit boundary now fires at name resolution and handshake rather than first payload byte. One advisory remains, on a single word.

findings.claim: The CA-2 clause uses SUPERSEDES against a doctor v4 recital, which is a closed status word applied between two unapplied candidates by an artifact that elsewhere states it does not apply doctor v4 and, for the parallel and more invasive effectOutcome case, expressly declines to amend it.
findings.evidence: coveredActs.CA-2.previewStanding reads: 'Therefore this contract SUPERSEDES, for preview host-effect purposes, doctor v4 consentDoesNotCascade.theHardCase insofar as that recital would permit a declared-local-only CA-2 under CA-2 alone.' Three statements in the same document need reconciling and are not reconciled. whatThisDoesNotDo states 'Does not apply doctor-contract.v4 or permission-truth-tables.v1.' outcomeVocabulary.doctorV4ReservedPoint, handling a far more invasive intervention — supplying the value vocabulary for a member v4 holds reserved — takes the disciplined form instead: 'It does not amend doctor v4's header. A later doctor successor may restate the reserved point as activated for host acts; until then these bytes are the normative host binding.' The CA-2 clause gets no equivalent sentence. Two things make the word choice the wrong one rather than merely inelegant. First, SUPERSEDED is a member of D-000's closed status vocabulary alongside ADOPTED, CONTESTED and OVERTURNED, and D-006 turn-2 NOTE-03 records that the closed status vocabulary stays closed; supersession in this corpus is an act an owning authority records, and no such act exists here — both artifacts are CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, this one declares binds NOTHING, and doctor v4 belongs to a row this contract has no authority over. Second, the artifact's own effectOutcome passage proves it knows the correct construction. I record clearly what this finding is not: the substantive position is right and is more restrictive rather than less, the scope is bounded twice over by 'for preview host-effect purposes' and 'insofar as', and the citation is exact — I read doctor v4's theHardCase in full and its closing sentence is 'Where the target's posture is declared local-only, doctor executes under CA-1/CA-2 alone and the post-report records, as a residual limitation, that the no-egress property is DECLARED and not enforced by doctor', which is precisely the permission the artifact says it is overriding.
findings.proposedFix: Restate in the form the artifact already uses for effectOutcome: this contract does not amend doctor v4; within the host-effect authorization domain it governs, the declared-local-only branch of consentDoesNotCascade.theHardCase does not make a preview CA-2 exercisable, and a later doctor successor may restate that recital. Reserve SUPERSEDES for an act an owning authority records.

verdictNote: ACCEPT-WITH-ADVISORIES. Across four versions this artifact has taken one blocker and three advisories from me and repaired every one at bytes, twice recording the measurement that exposed the error so it cannot recur. I attacked all twelve axes the prompt names and set out specifically to break three repairs — the CA-2 supersession, IN_PROCESS, and the 19/19 mapping — and all three held; the mapping I tested by set difference rather than by trusting mappedMemberCount, and the supersession I tested by reading the cited recital in full, where the artifact's characterization proved exact. The single advisory is one word in one clause: the substantive rule it carries is correct and more restrictive than what it displaces, and the artifact's own effectOutcome passage already contains the construction that would state it without borrowing a closed status word. That is a one-sentence repair and it does not, in my view, stand between this artifact and acceptance.
